title: Workday Jobs Scraper output
description: One record per job in the default dataset, plus a SUMMARY record describing the run.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Every job delivered, one record each: title, company, locations, category, posting date, apply URL, and (optionally) the description.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Jobs returned, what happened on each career site, why the run stopped, and any coverage warnings.
